Overall, Neighbor 5 still lands on the non-mutagenic side because the lower ring count, very low neutral fraction, higher maximum partial charge, and missing secondary aromatic amine collectively outweigh the higher TPSA.

Neighbor 6 is the one negative neighbor that clearly points in the mutagenic direction, so it provides the main counterweight to the A-leaning neighbors. Across the six neighbors, the balance still favors option (A). Even so, the aggregate of the five other comparisons leaves the query more convincingly aligned with option (A): is not mutagenic.
